headline: The hotel group Accor is rolling out its AI travel assistant, ALL Concierge, to its hotels around the world after a pilot of several months.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a large company moves a chat assistant to worldwide use, but the report is short and gives no figures.
importance_line: Hotel guests and Accor staff are the people who would use it, and a big hotel group is moving from testing to wide use, but the report gives no details on which hotels, when, or how well it works.
summary: Hospitality Inside reports that the hotel group Accor is introducing its chat-based travel assistant, ALL Concierge, worldwide after a pilot that lasted several months. The report says the assistant covers the whole customer journey and is also meant to help with internal processes as well as guest services.
notes: Source text is a very short summary; kept to what it says.
